name: Steam Remote Play
description: An unofficial Steam Remote Play client for PS5.
author: jmelovich
release_notes:
A native PS5 app for jailbroken consoles that acts as a Steam Remote Play client, allowing you to stream your PC's Steam library to your PS5. The console finds PCs running Steam on your local network, pairs with a PIN, and streams Big Picture Mode with hardware video decoding & most DualSense features. Your PC requires no additional software beyond a basic Steam installation.

Unofficial and not affiliated with Valve or Sony.

This is the initial release for the unofficial PS5 Steam Remote Play app. View the readme for detailed notes on what works & what doesn't.
